message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) under Chinese criminal law for this case.

Facts: Employer (谭某某) without construction qualification, failed to ensure safety measures (no safety helmets, no safety ropes) for temporary workers constructing an advertisement board. One worker (李某均) fell from scaffolding, suffered head injury, died. Safety supervision authority identified the person in charge (谭某某) as the principal responsible. He was arrested, confessed, and compensated.

This is a case of causing death due to unsafe production (dangerous work) without proper qualifications. Under Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "重大责任事故" (major responsibility accident) or "以危险方法危害公共安全罪"? Actually there is a specific offense: "重大责任事故罪" (Crime of major responsibility accident) under Article 133 of Criminal Law (as amended). It applies to persons who, due to negligence, cause a major accident resulting in death, serious injury, etc., and are responsible for safety production. The typical charge is "重大责任事故罪". In many examples above, similar facts (construction safety negligence leading to death) were labeled "重大责任事故". Indeed earlier examples: "浙江省宁波市镇海区人民检察院指控... 事故... 直接责任... A: 重大责任事故". Also "临沂市兰山区... 叉车... 死亡... A: 重大责任事故". So we should label as "重大责任事故". Possibly also "非法经营" if no qualification? But the main charge is "重大责任事故". The examples show they use that label.

Thus final answer: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>
